Name: I need to consolidate meetings into my 'demo' calendar, creating it if it doesn't exist. Search all my calendars for events scheduled between January 16 and 20, 2026, then move each identified event to the demo calendar while preserving all original details. Make sure that Alice Johnson (alice.manager@techcorp.com) is an attendee at the moved events, and give her writer-level access to the demo calendar. Set up a 45-minute popup reminder for each event and a private extended property with key 'consolidation' and value 'jan_2026_cleanup'. Finally, update the demo calendar's appearance by setting the background color to #16a765 and foreground color to #1d1d1d.
